name="fdict"
version="0.0.0"
license="MPL-2.0"
[library]
source-dir="playground-library"
include-dir=[".","playground-generated"]
[build]
auto-executables=false
auto-examples=false
auto-tests=false
[install]
library=true

scope: The current upstream Fypp templates produce fdict_types, variable and dictionary modules. Fypp 3.2 generates a checksum-locked asset with standard integer/real/complex/logical kinds, arrays through rank five, iso_fortran_env, optional extended kinds disabled and the upstream CMake default of non-pure interfaces. No CMake or Fypp runs in visitor preparation. The checked consumer stores and retrieves integer, real64, string and integer-array values, checks each returned value and frees the dictionary. N4 covers container storage and N5 covers key lookup. Earlier v0.7.1 preparation failed on missing generated includes; the current template generation resolves that blocker without downloading release assets or weakening archive checks. MPL-2.0 notices remain intact.
generated_source_support: See ../../fpm-generated-sources.md; exact assets and input hashes are included in local project exports. Generation runs only during operator maintenance.
resolved_preparation_blocker: Current Fypp 3.2 templates generate all three library modules; no incomplete v0.7.1 fallback or release-asset redirect is used. The first consumer used an unsupported success keyword on the character lookup; the verified consumer uses the documented character overload and checks its returned value.
